how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Rourkela Project Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate position at NIT Rourkela?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application for the Project Associate position at NIT Rourkela is 20th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B. Tech or M. Tech in relevant Food Engineering or Technology fields with a minimum CGPA of 6.5/10.0 and GATE/NET qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with relaxations available for SC/ST/PWD/Female and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on shortlisting according to merit and project needs, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of INR 31,000.00 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is NITR/SR/2026/Advt.-26FP043 /L/066.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The application process is via email. Candidates need to send their filled application and documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any desirable qualifications for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Yes, desirable qualifications include research experience in AI-ML, CAD, simulations, digital twin, protein characterization, and experience with rheometer and texture analyzer.

faq.question: Q10. When is the online interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The online interview for the Project Associate position is scheduled for 24th August 2026.
